title: Responsible Computing
chineseTitle: 负责任的计算与章末调查
topicSummary: Intellectual property, permission and attribution; open source, open access and Creative Commons boundaries; four simplified permission cards; a 35-minute evidence-based Community Shade Map review integrating access, bias, privacy and security.
homeworkInstructions: Complete all 12 original questions (30 marks, about 40 minutes). Q5 requires exactly TWO choices. Use the stated fictional scenarios, models and simplified permission cards. Explain each decision with evidence; never enter or submit real passwords or personal details.
